title: Causality Guided Representation Learning for Cross-Style Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through cross-style transfer experiments (training on explicit hate speech and testing on implicit hate speech, and vice versa) and testing on LLM-generated controlled style transformations to measure the model's over-reliance on surface-level lexical cues (e.g., overt slurs).

Evaluated by testing the model's hate speech detection performance across multiple datasets from different social media platforms (e.g., Twitter, synthetic environments) to measure its robustness against platform-specific linguistic artifacts and confounding factors.

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Gender, Race, Religion, Disability, Immigration Status)
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitatively evaluated by modeling the targeted demographic group as a separate latent variable in a causal graph, and utilizing t-SNE visualizations and case studies to confirm that the model's predictions are disentangled from specific demographic identities.
